metas.name: 2xx - first digit 2
metas.note: To be useful, the phone number has to have 10 digits, e.g. in a "111-111-11-11" format or similar. If it has only 7 digits, it has no area code and is'nt useful for identifying where you are.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
